customers.evidence: Our off-price values continued to resonate with our new and already loyal customers across all of our geographies.

employees.evidence: We have dedicated nearly 40 years to cultivating our merchandising talent

community.evidence: We brought our values to more consumers around the world

shareholders.evidence: while simultaneously driving superior financial returns and distributing cash to our shareholders through our share buyback and dividend programs

innovation.evidence: We are convinced that being leaders in innovation will keep us differentiated from the rest of the retail world

result.analyst_notes: Confident, celebratory tone centred on growth metrics, store expansion and market share. Shareholder returns and customer traffic lead the framing. Uses first-person plural and exclamation marks; commitments are stated absolutely (we are convinced, we are confident). Values are framed as off-price value mission, a recurring phrase.
